title: Intervention Specification
description: The Correction state variable, replacing the phrase "human in the loop". A human is part of the control system only to the extent they can causally alter its trajectory (Law IX). The spec states what the intervening owner can see, which actions they can prevent, which states they can alter, what happens when they disagree with the system, what incentives and costs bear on exercising the intervention, how fast they can reach it, and whether they are protected from retaliation. Every consequential delegation creates a correction obligation (Law IV); this is where that obligation is made concrete.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the spec conforms to.

spec_id.title: Spec identifier
spec_id.description: Stable identifier for the intervention spec, referenced by grants and safety object models.

system_ref.title: System reference
system_ref.description: Identifier of the system the intervention applies to.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The person or role who holds the intervention and can be reached to exercise it.

information_available.title: Information available
information_available.description: What the owner can actually see before and while intervening. Oversight without information is not control.

actions_preventable.title: Actions preventable
actions_preventable.description: Action classes the owner can stop before they take effect.

states_alterable.title: States alterable
states_alterable.description: Governing states the owner can change, such as a grant's state or a decision's status.

on_disagreement.title: On disagreement
on_disagreement.description: What happens after the owner disagrees with the system: who prevails, what pauses, and how the disagreement is recorded.

incentives.title: Incentives
incentives.description: The incentives bearing on the owner that make intervention more or less likely, stated honestly.

cost_to_exercise.title: Cost to exercise
cost_to_exercise.description: What it costs the owner or the institution to exercise the intervention, in time, money, or standing.

reach_time_target.title: Reach time target
reach_time_target.description: Target time for the owner to reach and exercise the intervention, as an ISO 8601 duration such as PT2H.

non_retaliation.title: Non-retaliation
non_retaliation.description: Protection for the owner against retaliation for intervening. A control that punishes its operator will not be used.

policy_ref.title: Policy reference
policy_ref.description: Identifier or URL of the non-retaliation policy.

attested.title: Attested
attested.description: Whether the protection has been attested by an accountable party.

mechanism.title: Mechanism
mechanism.description: The kind of intervention the owner can exercise.
